name: VTK.js Transfer Function Interface
aliases: Interactive Transfer Function Editing via Histogram Overlay
definition: A JavaScript class that provides an interactive UI for defining and editing volume rendering transfer functions (opacity and color) using control points, which are then applied to a VTK.js vtkVolume actor.
summary: The VTK.js Transfer Function Interface is a JavaScript class providing an interactive UI for editing volume rendering transfer functions via control points and histogram overlays.
